maya (arch): Quick note about deprecation semantics. When we start returning deprecation headers for removed fields, how do we avoid breaking clients that immediately fail on unknown fields? Need a strategy.

frank (eng-platform): We should use a dual-release approach: start with a header-only deprecation (X-Deprecation: fieldX; since=2026-05-01; warn-only) then a soft removal behind feature-flag, then hard remove after grace. This gives SDKs a visible channel.

victor (eng-runtime): From runtime perspective, unknown fields should be ignored gracefully by default and emit a metric unknown_field_{name}_count. Only in strict_mode (opt-in) do we return 4xx.

iris (eng-ml): For quirks where model behavior depends on a removed field, the harmonizer/conductor should translate or synthesize a compatible equivalent. If impossible, we should surface clear failure with a link to migration docs.

maya (arch): UX for customers: deprecation header + admin console timeline + ability to opt-out of removal for enterprise contracts. Also send owners a preview email 30 days before hard removal.

deep (eng-infra): Ops concern: schema mismatches between runtime and client will show up in logs and increase alert noise. Propose a rate-limited sampler that captures full request for reporting, while redacting PII.

frank (eng-platform): SDK changes: emit warning only once per client-key per day, and provide an API to fetch pending deprecations so integrators can check programmatically.

maya (arch): Example header format: X-Deprecation-Notice: fieldX;since=2026-05-01;remove=2026-08-01;advice=https://redwood.ai/mig-fieldX

victor (eng-runtime): For telemetry: unknown_field_heatmap by route, ingress_version_mismatch_rate, translation_applied_rate. Also we should track customer opt-in state for each migration.

iris (eng-ml): We'll flag rules that cause semantic divergence in translation and add a manual-review step before enabling auto-translation for those.

maya (arch): Decision: adopt header-first warn-only deprecations, ignore unknown fields by default, provide strict_mode as opt-in, and make enterprise exceptions available. Owners: frank (SDK), dee (ops), victor (runtime).

ops-bot: Deprecation RFC follow-up ticket created: DEPREC-1221.

maya (arch): adding action items: frank to update SDK warning behavior, dee to build request sampler, victor to add unknown_field metrics. Reconvene in 2 weeks for policy doc review.
